user.title: Connect the briefing service
user.description: Enter a Cerebras API key. Gmail is optional; when enabled, Home Assistant requests read-only access to summarize important unread messages and manages token refresh. CalDAV works with iCloud Calendar using an Apple app-specific password.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Gmail
reauth_confirm.description: Google authorization is needed again. Continue to reconnect Gmail.

reconfigure.title: Update briefing credentials
reconfigure.description: Leave the Cerebras API key blank to keep the saved key. To grant Gmail message-reading access, keep Gmail enabled and select Reconnect Gmail.

data.gmail_reconnect: Reconnect Gmail and grant message-read access

pick_implementation.title: Choose Google credentials
pick_implementation.description: Select the Google OAuth application credentials registered in Home Assistant.

auth.title: Authorize Gmail
auth.description: Authorize read-only Gmail access so the briefing can filter and summarize unread messages.

creation.title: Finish setup
creation.description: Complete the Gmail authorization to finish setting up the briefing.

abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: No Google OAuth credentials are registered in Home Assistant.
abort.oauth_error: Google OAuth could not be completed. Check the credentials and redirect URL.

init.title: Briefing settings
init.description: Choose which calendars and data sources to include. Select one or more CalDAV calendars to include only those; leave the calendar list empty to include all discovered calendars. Add optional person labels as calendar name = person. Reopen this page to refresh calendar discovery.

data.calendar_labels: Calendar labels (one per line: calendar name = person or label)

error.gmail_not_linked: Gmail is not linked. Use Reconfigure to connect Gmail first, or leave Gmail disabled.
